title: event
description: Triggers an event for the specified entity or entities.

target.title: target
target.description: Required. A `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify which entity the event is happening to.

eventname.title: eventName
eventname.description: Required. A `string` that specifies the in-game event.
